object_description: deep monolithic comb building with an entrance pavilion
design_condition: The building is placed parallel to the Allée des Marais with western access through the perimeter wall, while compact logistical circulation frees space for walks and sports fields.

positive.statement: The generous circulation areas, including expanded division corridors, provide overhead natural light.

position.rationale: Central comb corridors are approximated along the spine and upper branch circulation at elevated levels.

positive.statement: The surrounding wall is carefully treated to reduce its impact on the landscape and life within the establishment.

position.rationale: A perimeter-related landscape edge is approximated near the southwest access side of the site.

positive.statement: Differentiated walking courses support resocialization and contribute to the quality of integration in the environment.

position.rationale: Open circulation and walking space is estimated beside the comb’s eastern and southern edges.

positive.statement: The comb organization offers a good response to users and is intelligently developed with interesting elements.

position.rationale: The deep spine and repeated parallel branches are clearly identifiable across the calibrated views.

position.rationale: Freed open space is estimated along the southeast side outside the main comb footprint.

position.rationale: Phasing circulation is anchored to the central spine connecting the repeated branch bars.
